content.user_title: Find Your Next Cold-Email Workflow Step
content.value_statement: Cold-email operators can struggle to identify which setup or campaign task comes next. This skill reviews project readiness and routes them to a relevant companion workflow.
actual_capabilities: Check brand configuration, voice documentation, PSP, EVP, and sending infrastructure for workflow readiness.
Recommend a deliverability review when the recorded audit is at least 30 days old.
Route operators to onboarding, sequence drafting, reply scoring, program auditing, or weekly planning.
Present a seven-step welcome checklist and request confirmation before onboarding.
Summarize project readiness and campaign activity through the parent skill status mode.
Support explicit resumption at a named workflow step, regardless of detected state.
limitations: Provides routing instructions and pseudocode, not a standalone executable campaign system.
Depends on the parent cold-email skill and companion skills for the routed workflows.
Requires accurate local configuration and campaign logs; missing or outdated records can affect recommendations.
Does not itself send email, verify live deliverability, or guarantee campaign results.

use_cases.title: Start an outbound program
use_cases.description: Identify missing brand and voice setup, then begin the appropriate onboarding workflow.

use_cases.title: Review launch readiness
use_cases.description: Check messaging, infrastructure, audit recency, and first-send status before choosing the next campaign task.

use_cases.title: Resume campaign improvement
use_cases.description: Use logged replies to move toward program auditing and recurring campaign planning.

prompt_templates.title: Find a starting point
prompt_templates.prompt: I am new to cold email. Check this project and tell me the next step.

prompt_templates.title: Review program status
prompt_templates.prompt:
/cold-email status
Summarize the available project state and recommend the next step. Mark missing information as unknown.

prompt_templates.title: Check first-campaign readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Our brand setup, PSP, and EVP are complete. Check infrastructure and audit recency before recommending the first sequence workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Resume iteration deliberately
prompt_templates.prompt:
/cold-email resume iterate
Use available experiment logs and reply data to recommend an audit or weekly planning workflow. Report unresolved prerequisites separately.

output_examples.input: A new project has no brand configuration or voice document.
output: Missing: brand configuration and voice documentation.

output_examples.input: Brand setup, PSP, EVP, and infrastructure exist, but the last deliverability audit was 45 days ago.
output: The recorded audit is older than 30 days.
Next step: cold-email-deliverability before drafting the first sequence.

output_examples.input: A campaign has logged sends and replies, with current setup and deliverability records.
output: Next step: cold-email-audit to review the program.
Alternative: cold-email-weekly-rhythm for recurring campaign planning.

best_practices: Keep brand configuration, audit dates, and experiment logs current before requesting a status review.
Confirm companion skills are available and review their permissions before following a routed workflow.
Use detected readiness as the default; review unresolved prerequisites when resuming a specific step.
anti_patterns: Treating example status figures as verified measurements for your own campaign.
Assuming a routing recommendation means email was sent or live deliverability was checked.
Using resume mode to ignore missing setup or an outdated deliverability review.

faq.question: How is this skill activated?
faq.answer: The parent cold-email skill loads it for a bare invocation or starting-point questions. The source marks kickoff as not directly user-invocable.

faq.question: Which project information does it check?
faq.answer: It checks brand and voice files, PSP, EVP, infrastructure, audit recency, send logs, and reply availability.

faq.question: Does it send cold emails?
faq.answer: No. It recommends the next workflow and delegates campaign tasks to companion skills.

faq.question: When does it recommend a deliverability review?
faq.answer: It recommends a baseline review when infrastructure is missing, or another review when the recorded audit is at least 30 days old.

faq.question: Can I resume a specific step?
faq.answer: Yes. The parent resume mode accepts onboarding, psp, evp, infrastructure, deliverability, first-send, or iterate, regardless of detected state.

faq.question: Does this skill include every required workflow?
faq.answer: No. It references companion workflows and recommends separate PSP and EVP skill installations. Those dependencies are not included in the reviewed file.
